# fuzz.txt wordlist — one test case per line, format: attr:value
#
#   attr  = numeric RADIUS attribute type (0-255) or a known name
#           (case-insensitive, see dictionary.go), e.g. "User-Password" or "2"
#   value = a literal UTF-8 string, or hex:<hexstring> for raw/binary bytes
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are skipped.
#
# For each case, a seed PAP request is built from the scenario's
# username/password. If attr matches an attribute already in the seed
# (User-Name=1, User-Password=2), its value is REPLACED with this line's
# value (bypassing normal PAP encryption for User-Password, letting you
# inject raw/malformed bytes directly). Otherwise the attribute is APPENDED
# alongside the valid seed credentials.

# --- Fuzzing the password field itself (type 2 -> REPLACED) ---
User-Password:hex:00
User-Password:
2:hex:

# --- Fuzzing the username field itself (type 1 -> REPLACED) ---
User-Name:hex:2727204f52202731273d2731
User-Name:

# --- Fuzzing attributes NOT in the seed (APPENDED alongside valid creds) ---
State:hex:00112233
EAP-Message:hello
79:hex:0100000501
26:hex:0000000900000000
250:hex:deadbeef

# --- Deliberately oversized value (300 bytes, so 2+len(value) > 255): the
#     Length byte will wrap rather than the client erroring or truncating
#     (see README) ---
Filter-Id:hex:
